what_you_believe_happened: Signed in, clicked the prominent 'Log site report' button on Home. A 'New site report' dialog opened with Kapoor Villa (Audit) preselected. I entered 'Shuttering complete on east wing' in Work done today, 12 in People on site, and 'No accidents' in Delays or problems, then clicked 'Send for approval'. A toast said 'Draft sent for approval.' and the Inbox badge went from 1 to 2; Inbox > Change requests > 'Sent by me' showed 2. The report is therefore submitted as an approval request, not yet approved/saved.
unnecessary_steps: Had to decide myself where 'no accidents' belongs since there is no accidents/safety field (used Delays or problems)
confusing_terminology: 'Send for approval' -> I was not sure whether this submits the report or only a draft; toast says 'Draft sent for approval'
'Change requests' in Inbox -> unclear this is where my report went
'Delays or problems' -> not an obvious place for 'no accidents'
missing_feedback: Home card 'Today's site report' still showed 'Not sent yet / Waiting' after submission, contradicting the toast
Toast disappears quickly and gives no link to the submitted report
Inbox 'Sent by me 2' lists no visible items in my quick look so I could not confirm the report content
unexpected_behaviour: Home card status did not update after sending
visual_issues: Placeholder text in fields is grey and low contrast; the username field showed 'admin' placeholder which looks like a prefilled value
accessibility_issues: Keyboard use not tested; low-contrast placeholder and small grey labels
observations: Very discoverable: primary 'Log site report' button on Home, project preselected, helpful example placeholders. Main weakness is unclear post-submit state and the draft/approval wording.

rating_justifications.system_feedback: After submitting, toast said 'Draft sent for approval.' but Home card still read 'Not sent yet / Waiting', and I could not see the submitted report anywhere to confirm.
